```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 200
)
sections <- params$sections %||% character(0)
has <- function(x) x %in% sections
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a
```

# IMGT/PROMISE — Automatically Generated Report

This report was generated automatically from the current state of the
IMGT/PROMISE application, reflecting the parameters and analyses selected
by the user at the time of export.

---

## 1. Dataset Overview

```{r dataset-summary, results='asis'}
ds <- params$dataset_summary
if (!is.null(ds)) {
  cat("**Total sequences:** ", ds$n, "\n\n")
  cat("**Loci included:** ", paste(sort(unique(ds$loci)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  if (!is.null(params$species) && nzchar(params$species))
    cat("**Species focus (descriptive table):** ", params$species, "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("_Dataset not built at export time._\n\n")
}
```

---

```{r tableau-section, results='asis', eval=has("tableau")}
cat("## 2. Descriptive Table by Species\n\n")
if (!is.null(params$tableau) && nrow(params$tableau) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(params$tableau, digits = 2))
} else {
  cat("_No descriptive table was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r freq-section, results='asis', eval=has("freq")}
cat("## 3. Motif Presence Frequencies\n\n")
fr <- params$freq
if (!is.null(fr) && !is.null(fr$data) && nrow(fr$data) > 0) {
  tryCatch({
    p <- plot_motif_frequencies(fr$data, grouping = "species", interactive = FALSE)
    print(p)
  }, error = function(e) cat("_Plot could not be rendered: ", e$message, "_\n\n"))
  cat("\n**Statistical tests (Chi-square / Fisher, Bonferroni-corrected):**\n\n")
  if (!is.null(fr$stat_tests) && nrow(fr$stat_tests) > 0) {
    print(knitr::kable(fr$stat_tests, digits = 4))
  } else {
    cat("_No statistical tests available._\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("_No frequency analysis was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r diversity-section, results='asis', eval=has("diversity")}
cat("## 4. Motif Diversity\n\n")
dv <- params$diversity
if (!is.null(dv) && !is.null(dv$data) && nrow(dv$data) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(dv$data, digits = 3))
  cat("\n**Diversity indices** (Shannon, Simpson, Richness, Evenness) summarize how ",
      "varied motif profiles are within each group.\n\n")
  if (!is.null(dv$tests) && nrow(dv$tests) > 0) {
    cat("\n**Kruskal-Wallis tests:**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(dv$tests, digits = 4))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No diversity analysis was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r clustering-section, results='asis', eval=has("clustering")}
cat("## 5. Hierarchical Clustering\n\n")
cl <- params$clustering
if (!is.null(cl) && !is.null(cl$hc)) {
  tryCatch({
    plot(cl$hc, main = "Hierarchical Clustering", xlab = "Subgroups",
         ylab = "Height (dissimilarity)", sub = "", cex = 0.7)
  }, error = function(e) cat("_Dendrogram could not be rendered._\n\n"))
  if (!is.null(cl$assignments)) {
    df_assign <- data.frame(
      Subgroup = names(cl$assignments),
      Cluster  = as.integer(cl$assignments)
    )
    cat("\n**Cluster assignments:**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(df_assign))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No clustering analysis was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r identity-section, results='asis', eval=has("identity")}
cat("## 6. Sequence Identity\n\n")
idn <- params$identity
if (!is.null(idn) && nrow(idn) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(head(idn, 50), digits = 2))
  if (nrow(idn) > 50) cat("\n_(table truncated to first 50 rows)_\n\n")
} else {
  cat("_No sequence identity analysis was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r regression-section, results='asis', eval=has("regression")}
cat("## 7. Logistic Regression\n\n")
rg <- params$regression
if (!is.null(rg) && !is.null(rg$data) && nrow(rg$data) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(rg$data, digits = 3))
  if (!is.null(rg$cv) && !is.null(rg$cv$metrics_global)) {
    m <- rg$cv$metrics_global
    cat("\n**Cross-validated performance:**\n\n")
    cat("- Accuracy: ", round(m$Accuracy, 3), "\n")
    cat("- AUC: ", round(m$AUC, 3), "\n")
    cat("- F1: ", round(m$F1, 3), "\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("_No logistic regression model was run before export._\n\n")
}
```

```{r consfunc-section, results='asis', eval=has("cons_func")}
cat("## 8. Conservation by Functionality\n\n")
cf <- params$cons_func
if (!is.null(cf) && !is.null(cf$data) && nrow(cf$data) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(head(cf$data, 50), digits = 3))
  if (!is.null(cf$chi) && nrow(cf$chi) > 0) {
    cat("\n**Chi-square tests (motif presence vs functionality):**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(cf$chi, digits = 4))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No conservation/functionality analysis was generated before export._\n\n")
}
```


## Methodological Notes

This report reflects the exact state of the analyses as displayed in the
IMGT/PROMISE application at the moment of export (no analysis is
recomputed during report generation). Sections that were not launched by
the user before export are reported as unavailable rather than
recalculated automatically.

*Generated by IMGT/PROMISE.*
